invariants.description: Exact nonsequential uint16 indices reuse vertices and remain pixel-sensitive.
Near geometry remains visible in the overlap after farther indices are issued.
A nonoverlap probe independently proves that the farther geometry was issued.
The isolated reverse-winding diagnostic is visible when raster culling is disabled.
The same issued geometry and transform remove only the reverse-winding diagnostic under back-face culling.
Disjoint probes establish that near projected extent exceeds far projected extent.
Texture probes bind top-left image-edge UV orientation and sampling.
Animation changes one 64-byte logical vertex-stage constant without prescribing its backend storage.
Vertex, index, texture, and pipeline identities remain stable across transform and resize checkpoints.
Presentation extent, depth attachment, resolved transform, and output advance atomically.
The old depth attachment retires after completion and no extent-dependent attachment remains live at teardown.
The portrait resolved transform uses the new pixel-width divided by pixel-height aspect.
